title: The Patron's Gift
subtitle: You pick. Nobody picks for you
description: A `tasked:choice` reward waits for the pick: the entries go to the
player and the claim marks nothing until one is answered, so a
crash between the offer and the answer loses nothing.
A choice reward is never auto-granted, whatever its `auto` says --
its payout IS the pick. A file that asks an automatic mode of it
gets a warning at load, which is the validator's way of saying the
setting would read as supported when it is not.
